Mox Bookshelf Customization Process

A structured workflow designed to deliver high-quality, customized shelving solutions

1

Requirement Consultation

Define your needs clearly.We discuss your space, usage, and budget to understand your project requirements.

2

Design & Solution Proposal

Customized shelving solution.Our team provides layout plans and design suggestions tailored to your needs.

3

Drawing Confirmation

Finalize all details.We confirm dimensions, materials, and structure before production begins.

4

Sample Production (Optional)

Check before bulk production.Samples can be made to ensure quality and design meet your expectations.

5

Mass Production & Quality Control

Efficient and controlled manufacturing.We carry out mass production with strict quality control at every step.

6

Packaging & Delivery

Safe and on-time shipment.Products are securely packed and delivered with full support.

Certified to international standards: FSC, BSCI, SGS.

Frequently Asked Questions

Please contact our Customer Support Team at help@moxfur.com for more information!

I placed an order where is it?

Once your order ships, you will receive a confirmation email with tracking details so you can follow the delivery progress.

Where can I find a store?

You can use our store locator page to find the nearest retail location and view current opening hours.

How can I sign in to my account?

Select the account icon in the header and use your email address to sign in or create a new customer account.

How long does shipping take?

Standard shipping usually arrives within 3 to 7 business days depending on your destination and order timing.

How do I start a return?

Please contact our support team with your order number and we will guide you through the return or exchange process.
